name: Open Notebook
description: Private, multi-model, self-hosted alternative to Google NotebookLM for researching and discussing your sources.
whatItDoes: Organises sources into notebooks, lets you chat with them, take notes and generate podcasts, while keeping the data on your own machine. It is for people who want NotebookLM-style research with their choice of AI provider.
howItWorks: A web front end and API run in Docker alongside SurrealDB for storage. Model providers are configured by the user, and an MCP integration lets external clients such as Claude Desktop reach the notebooks. Setup is a downloaded docker-compose file plus a few environment values.

requirements.name: LLM provider
requirements.description: Key for at least one AI provider, or a local model
